resources.string: An Arch Linux ARM AArch64 environment on Android

ThothTerm Rolling runs an Arch Linux ARM AArch64 environment. This app is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Arch Linux or Arch Linux ARM projects. Arch Linux is a trademark of Levente Polyák and Judd Vinet, on behalf of Arch Linux.\n\nThe environment is a PRoot userland, not a booted Arch Linux ARM system: pacman and ordinary programs work, while services that need systemd as PID 1 (systemctl) are not available.
Arch Linux ARM needs to be downloaded

ThothTerm Rolling runs an Arch Linux ARM %1$s environment. This build does not include it, so it has to be downloaded before the terminal can start.

Download size: about %2$d MB
From: %3$s

What you are agreeing to:
• This downloads executable software onto your device after installation.
• It consists of unmodified packages from the Arch Linux ARM repositories, each checked against Arch Linux ARM’s signing key when the ThothTerm project assembled them into a root filesystem, and published unchanged since. Arch Linux ARM did not build or endorse this download.
• It is not part of this app’s package and was not built or verified by F‑Droid.
• ThothTerm checks the download’s size and SHA‑256 checksum against values fixed in this app’s source, and refuses it if they do not match. A failed or interrupted download changes nothing and can be retried.
• LAN Mode stays off unless you turn it on. When it is on, terminal traffic and uploaded files are not encrypted in transit: use it only on networks you trust.

Nothing is downloaded unless you choose Download Arch Linux ARM.
Arch Linux ARM was not downloaded. You can start the download whenever you want.
LAN Mode lets a computer on the same Wi-Fi network use this Arch Linux ARM environment in a web browser. Each browser gets a terminal of its own; the windows on this phone are not shared.
